en.name: Long-range context
en.explanation: Your Solar Anchor falls inside the 210° to <240° long-range context interval. CC08 is its technical index; the zodiac name is a position label, not a personality claim.

en.name: Reality Grammar
en.explanation: This is the selected Reality Grammar position in the calculated baseline. G11 is a coordinate index, not a fixed identity label.

en.name: Baseline question
en.explanation: This baseline question is paired to the same Grammar ordinal. It is a question to observe when that grammar becomes relevant, not a predetermined life conclusion.

en.name: Response capability
en.explanation: Primary response capability selected by the versioned Question → Capability matrix. The mapping describes a governed response resource, not a score of personal ability.

en.name: Baseline driver affinity
en.explanation: This driver is ranked from circular distance to the Solar Anchor in the twelve-driver baseline profile. The rank does not state what is most important in your current Reality.

en.name: Change motion
en.explanation: This is the selected PHI OS organization-change motion. The trigram identity is reused as a structural symbol without importing I Ching fortune meaning.

en.name: Environment-response configuration
en.explanation: This configuration combines an upper-trigram Environment Priority with a lower-trigram Embodied Response Position. ECR-H41 is the configuration index, not a traditional hexagram fortune judgment.

en.name: Activation stage
en.explanation: This is the position within the selected H64 segment. It describes a runtime activation stage, not luck, success probability or a guaranteed event.

zh-Hans.name: 长期方向背景
zh-Hans.explanation: 你的太阳锚点位于 210°–<240° 的长期背景区间。CC08 是这个区间的技术编号；星座名称只用于位置标记，不代表人格判断。

zh-Hans.name: 现实语法
zh-Hans.explanation: 这是计算基线中命中的现实语法位置。G11 是坐标编号，不是固定人格或身份标签。

zh-Hans.name: 基础问题
zh-Hans.explanation: 这个基础问题与同序号的现实语法配对。它用于观察该语法出现时什么问题会变得重要，并不是预先决定的人生结论。

zh-Hans.name: 回应能力
zh-Hans.explanation: 这是版本化“问题 → 能力”矩阵映射出的主要回应能力。它描述受治理的回应资源，不是个人能力高低评分。

zh-Hans.name: 出生基线驱动
zh-Hans.explanation: 这个驱动来自 12 项驱动与太阳锚点的圆周距离排序。这里的名次只表示出生基线亲和度，不代表你此刻现实中真正最重要的驱动力。

zh-Hans.name: 变化运动
zh-Hans.explanation: 这是当前命中的 PHI OS 组织变化运动。这里只复用卦象身份作为结构符号，不导入易经吉凶或占卜意义。

zh-Hans.name: 环境—回应构型
zh-Hans.explanation: 这个构型把上卦作为“环境优先运动”，下卦作为“载体回应位置”。ECR-H41 是构型索引，不是传统卦辞的吉凶判断。

zh-Hans.name: 激活阶段
zh-Hans.explanation: 这是当前 H64 构型区间内部的位置阶段，用来描述运行激活状态；它不是吉凶、成功概率或必然事件。

en.title: Everyone has a configuration.
en.subtitle: No chart can replace the whole of real life.
en.html:
Different methods can offer ways to understand ourselves, while many questions remain unanswered.

Why can the same ability lead to different outcomes in different environments?

Why do some things repeatedly attract our attention while others leave us drained?

Why do choices that once worked need reconsideration when life's conditions change?

PHI Configuration is an original configuration method developed by PHI OS.

It uses its own calculation and interpretation structure to organize positions, drivers, responses and environmental relationships, offering another perspective on personal configuration.

It does not equate a calculated chart with a person's entire reality.

en.title: We have many ways of interpreting people.
en.subtitle: The difficult question is how far an interpretation can go.
en.html:
Different cultures and periods have developed different ways of describing people and the world.

BaZi uses four pillars and five phases. Zi Wei organizes themes through palaces and stars. Astrology uses planets, houses and aspects for symbolic reading. Numerology uses defined number roles and cycles. Human Design uses concepts such as the BodyGraph, centers, channels and authority.

Each has its own traditions, structures and interpretive scope.

A person's lived experience also involves work, family, relationships, finances, resources, physical circumstances, environment and changing conditions.

Models describe different structures. They do not automatically verify these real circumstances.

PHI Configuration arose from a PHI OS question: can an independently defined configuration language show structural relationships while clearly preserving the distinction between interpretation and fact?

What PHI Configuration is not

It is not a blend of BaZi, astrology or Human Design. Agreement between methods is not used as proof that a conclusion is true. It does not claim to explain a person's entire life at once.

What it aims to offer

Structure: a configuration that can be examined, checked and explored.

Connections: positions and interpretations read in relationship, rather than as disconnected labels.

Questions: observations worth investigating further.

Boundaries: a distinction between calculation, interpretation and what remains unknown.

Reality: space for lived experience, environment and actual choice.

en.title: An original configuration method emerging from PHI OS research into reality.
en.html:
PHI Configuration is not presented as a direct continuation of an ancient divinatory school.

It has developed as an independent method within PHI OS's existing knowledge framework, Reality Grammar and research into questions and responses.

That research asks how we can retain what is observable and interpretable among many objects, relationships, constraints and changes, without allowing a single model to replace the whole.

PHI Configuration organizes part of that structure into a language for personal configuration.

Three directions of development

01 · The structure of reality

Conditions, relationships and constraints exist together. Life includes actual external circumstances as well as inner experience.

02 · Questions and responses

PHI OS Reality Grammar and response frameworks organize questions and related structures. These rules contribute to an independent calculation system rather than importing judgments wholesale from another method.

03 · Configuration and reading

Birth information, the formal algorithm and corresponding coordinates establish a baseline configuration. Calculation, interpretation and actual experience are then kept distinct in a bounded reading.

Original does not mean scientifically validated

PHI Configuration is an original PHI OS model. Reproducible calculations and explainable definitions do not automatically establish empirical predictive validity for personality, ability, events or the future.

en.title: Eight layers form a configuration you can explore in depth.
en.html:
PHI Configuration has its own formal calculation and interpretation coordinates. Read the following layers against the current Canonical version.

01 · Long-range context

The long-range background coordinate used in this calculation. A position label is not a personality verdict.

02 · Reality Grammar

The grammar position organizes particular questions for observation.

03 · Baseline question

A question corresponding to that grammar, without deciding a person's real answer in advance.

04 · Response capability

Resources organized by versioned rules. A model capability position is not a real-world skill score.

05 · Baseline driver affinity

How driver relationships are arranged in the birth baseline. A position does not prove what currently motivates a person most.

06 · Change motion

The PHI OS structural language for change relationships. Its symbols must not be equated with traditional judgments of good or bad fortune.

07 · Environment–response configuration

Environment conditions and response positions read together. Actual surroundings still require real information to confirm.

08 · Activation stage

A stage position within the model, not the time of a future event or a probability of success.

From one position to a wider relationship

Select a supported chart position to examine its layer, calculation basis, relationships and interpretive limits.

en.title: One configuration can be read from different angles.
en.html:
Eight formal coordinate layers define the model structure. Six customer-facing questions make that structure easier to approach.

01 · Structure

How does this configuration organize positions and relationships?

02 · Drivers

Which driver relationships does the model show? What actually motivates you in real life?

03 · Available capabilities

Which capability roles does the model propose? Which abilities have been demonstrated in practice?

04 · Tension

Which relationships deserve checking? Which conflicts remain possible interpretations rather than observed facts?

05 · Field

How do environment, work, family, resources and social conditions affect actual action?

06 · Phase

As time and conditions change, which questions deserve another look?

These six questions help explain the configuration. They do not replace the formal eight-layer calculation.

They help readers organize questions rather than pass judgment on a person.

en.title: See how calculated positions organize relationships.
en.html:
PHI Configuration uses formal birth information to establish a baseline.

Birth and Design positions follow their respective specified calculation paths, using shared coordinate and boundary conventions.

Explore calculated activations, symbols and related layers.

Begin with the whole chart

Understand the overall arrangement before selecting individual positions.

Read Birth and Design separately

Keep the two sets of positions and their sources distinct. Visual proximity does not establish causation.

Open the eight-layer structure

Explore context, grammar, question, capability, driver, motion, environment and stage.

Examine calculation details

Check the birth information, time, algorithm version and actual calculation record used for the result.

This section uses the existing admitted public synthetic example. Only a result obtained from personal input can be labelled as your configuration for this reading.

en.title: The same person can face very different choices under different conditions.
en.html:
Configuration reading should leave space for lived experience rather than staying entirely inside a chart.

Work and time

Someone with substantial experience may be unable to take a job because of care responsibilities, scheduling or finances. Their ability has not disappeared. What can be used now and the conditions currently available are different questions.

Relationships and communication

Two people may have different expectations. A model interpretation can suggest a topic for discussion; it cannot speak for either person's actual thoughts. Understanding still requires listening, communication and both people's experience.

Resources and change

The same goal can have different feasibility when resources are abundant or constrained. Reading can help frame questions; budgets, responsibilities, support and risks need separate checking.

A model can suggest an observation angle. Actual conditions determine which actions are feasible.

en.title: Use your birth information to establish this reading's configuration.
en.html:
Enter the accurate birth date, birth time and confirmed birthplace required by the formal method.

The existing deterministic engine provides free calculation without an LLM.

Step 1 · Confirm the information

Confirm date, accurate time, place and consent for this calculation.

Step 2 · View your configuration

After calculation, view the personal configuration, positions and eight-layer structures actually supported for this input.

Step 3 · Read the free content

Free reading includes admitted introductory explanations, an explorable chart and fixed report pages where formally available. It does not require purchasing the full report.

Step 4 · Compare with reality

Optionally record whether a theme agrees, partly agrees, disagrees or cannot yet be assessed against experience you already know.

Your response does not alter the calculation or automatically count as evidence that the method is valid.

en.title: Continue from the chart into ten connected chapters.
en.html:
The free reading introduces the calculated structure. The full report organizes admitted relationships, interpretations and themes across the existing formal ten chapters.

The canonical chapter names and order remain controlled by the existing report registry. Reality comparison, PHI Card reflection, navigation and continuity are separate interactive reading material, not additional formal paid chapters.

The value of a full report

Explore the structure and connections between layers in greater depth while retaining interpretation boundaries. Reality comparison helps distinguish what you actually know from what remains unclear.

en.title: One purchase, a reading you can return to.
en.html:
When purchase is formally available, register or sign in to PHI OS Account first.

Confirm the formal product, price, report subject, calculation version and information-use conditions before payment and generation.

After delivery, the report is bound to the correct Account. Reading and original-version downloads follow the purchased rights.

Saving does not alter the calculation or interpretation limits. A future version does not silently overwrite an older file.

Where purchase is not open, display the accurate current state. A free reading is not a full paid report.

en.title: Compare readings without confusing their sources.
en.html:
PHI Configuration retains independent calculation and interpretation rules. BaZi, Zi Wei, astrology, numerology and Human Design retain their own structures.

You can choose to compare their questions and connections with your experience.

Similarity is not factual proof. Difference does not establish that one method must be wrong. PHI OS does not make symbolic methods vote on who you are.

Your reality keeps its own place

Work, family responsibilities, finances and actual choices should not be overwritten by a model.

en.title: A configuration is a starting point for observation.
en.html:
Build structure from birth information, examine relationships, and use those relationships to frame questions worth exploring.

Continue into PHI OS Knowledge or choose a Personal, Family, Business or Financial perspective.

PHI Configuration does not make every judgment for you. It helps keep model, evidence, reality and uncertainty distinct in your own judgment.

PHI OS — One Real World. Six Perspectives.

*Understand configuration. Keep reality in view. Continue choosing.*

zh-Hans.title: 每个人都有自己的构型。
zh-Hans.subtitle: 但没有一张图，能够代替完整的现实。
zh-Hans.html:
我们可以从不同方法认识自己，却依然可能有很多没有答案的问题。

为什么同样的能力，在不同环境里会呈现不同的结果？

为什么某些事情会反复吸引我们的注意，而另一些事情却让人感到消耗？

为什么人生条件改变后，原本可行的选择也需要重新考虑？

PHI Configuration 是 PHI OS 建立的原创构型方法。

它使用自己的计算与解释结构，组织不同位置、驱动、回应和环境关系，帮助读者从另一种角度理解个人构型。

但它不会将一张计算图表等同于一个人的全部现实。

zh-Hans.title: 我们不缺少解释人的方法。
zh-Hans.subtitle: 真正困难的是：如何知道一种解释可以走多远？
zh-Hans.html:
不同文化和时代，发展出不同的方式来描述人与世界。

八字使用四柱与五行。

紫微斗数通过宫位与星曜组织人生主题。

占星通过行星、宫位与相位进行象征阅读。

数字学从特定数字角色与周期建立解释。

人类图则使用 BodyGraph、中心、通道及权威等概念。

这些方法各有自己的传统与结构，也有各自的解释范围。

然而，一个人真正经历的生活，还涉及工作、家庭、关系、经济条件、资源、身体状态、环境及不断变化的现实。

不同的模型能够描述不同的结构，却不能自动替我们确认这些现实。

PHI Configuration 的出现，是 PHI OS 尝试回应这个问题的结果：

能否建立一套具有独立规则的构型语言，既能呈现结构关系，也能清楚保留解释与事实之间的区别？

PHI Configuration 不是什么？

它不是八字、占星或人类图的混合结果。

它不以多个方法得出相同解释，作为某个结论真实的证明。

它也不宣称能够一次性解释一个人的全部人生。

PHI Configuration 希望提供什么？

结构 — 一份能够查阅、核对和继续深入的构型。

联系 — 不把不同位置和解释割裂成独立标签。

问题 — 让阅读产生值得继续观察的问题。

边界 — 说明哪些来自计算，哪些只是解释，哪些仍然未知。

现实 — 让个人经历、环境和实际选择继续拥有自己的位置。

zh-Hans.title: 从 PHI OS 的现实研究，发展出原创构型方法。
zh-Hans.html:
PHI Configuration 并非从某一古代命理流派直接延伸而来。

它是在 PHI OS 已有知识框架、现实语法与回应问题的研究基础上，逐步组织出的一套独立构型方法。

PHI OS 对现实的研究关注一个共同问题：

当世界中存在许多不同的对象、关系、约束与变化时，我们如何保留其中可以观察、可以解释，又不会被单一模型完全替代的部分？

PHI Configuration 尝试把其中部分结构组织成个人构型语言。

从三个方向理解它的形成

01 · 现实的结构

现实中不同条件、关系和约束同时存在。

一个人的生活不只有内在感受，也包含真实的外部环境。

02 · 问题与回应

PHI OS 的现实语法和回应框架，提供了一种组织问题及其相关结构的方式。

这些规则参与 PHI Configuration 的独立计算体系，而不是直接照搬其他命理方法的判断。

03 · 构型与阅读

通过出生资料、正式算法及相应坐标，建立可供阅读的基线构型。

之后再将计算结果、方法解释与真实经历分开，形成有边界的个人阅读。

原创不意味着已经得到科学验证

PHI Configuration 是 PHI OS 提出的原创模型。

它的计算规则可以复核，内部定义可以说明，但这些并不自动证明模型对于人格、能力、事件或未来的解释具有实证预测效力。

zh-Hans.title: 八个层次，组织成一张可以深入探索的构型图。
zh-Hans.html:
PHI Configuration 具有自己的正式计算与解释坐标。

以下八层应按当前 Canonical 版本阅读。

01 · 长期方向背景

认识本次计算所采用的长期背景坐标。

其位置标记不等同于人格判决。

02 · 现实语法

确定本次结构中对应的现实语法位置，用于组织特定观察问题。

03 · 基础问题

为相应语法提供可探索的基础问题，不提前决定一个人的现实答案。

04 · 回应能力

呈现版本化规则所组织的回应资源。

这是模型中的能力位置，不是现实技能评分。

05 · 出生基线驱动

说明模型怎样排列出生基线中的驱动关系。

驱动位置不能自动证明现在最重要的个人动机。

06 · 变化运动

使用 PHI OS 的结构化变化语言，帮助组织不同变化关系。

不能将符号直接等同于传统占卜中的吉凶判断。

07 · 环境—回应构型

把环境条件与回应位置放在同一结构中阅读。

真实环境仍需要实际资料才能确认。

08 · 激活阶段

认识模型内部的阶段位置。

这不是未来事件发生时间，也不是成功概率。

从一个位置，进入更完整的关系

选择构型图中的任意已支持位置，进一步查看对应层次、计算依据、关联说明和解释边界。

zh-Hans.title: 一份构型，为什么可以从不同角度阅读？
zh-Hans.html:
八层正式坐标构成模型结构。

而为了让普通客户理解这套结构，PHI OS 将阅读组织为六个易于理解的问题。

01 · 结构

这份构型如何组织不同位置与关系？

02 · 驱动力

模型呈现了什么驱动关系？现实中真正推动你的因素是什么？

03 · 可用能力

模型提出了哪些能力角色？哪些能力已经在现实中得到实际证明？

04 · 张力

哪些关系值得进一步检查？哪些冲突只是可能的解释，而不是已发生的事实？

05 · 场域

环境、工作、家庭、资源与社会条件，怎样影响真实行动？

06 · 阶段

当时间和条件发生变化，哪些问题值得重新观察？

六个问题帮助理解构型，不取代正式八层计算。

它们的价值不是替一个人下结论，而是帮助读者把不同结构整理成更清楚的问题。

zh-Hans.title: 从计算位置，看见构型怎样组织联系。
zh-Hans.html:
PHI Configuration 使用正式出生资料建立基线构型。

图表中的 Birth 和 Design 位置由各自规定的计算路径产生，并使用共同的坐标与边界规则。

你可以在图表上探索已计算的激活位置、符号和相关层次。

从整张图开始

先认识整体排列，再选择个别位置阅读。

阅读 Birth 与 Design

区分两组计算位置及其来源，不因图形靠近就自动推断因果关系。

展开八层结构

逐步查看长期背景、语法、问题、回应、驱动、变化、环境及阶段。

查看计算明细

了解本次结果使用的出生资料、时间、算法版本及实际计算记录。

本区使用正式获准的公开合成案例。只有通过个人输入取得的结果，才可以被标示为本次个人构型。

zh-Hans.title: 同一个人，不同条件，可能面对完全不同的选择。
zh-Hans.html:
PHI Configuration 不应该只停留在图表内部。

它还需要为现实经验留下空间。

情境一 · 工作与时间

一个人可能拥有丰富的工作经验，却因为照顾责任、时间安排或经济条件而无法接受某项工作。

这不表示能力凭空消失。

它提醒我们：现实中能够使用的能力，与当下具备的条件并不是同一件事。

情境二 · 关系与沟通

两个人可能对一段关系有不同期待。

某项模型解释可以提示值得讨论的主题，但不能替其中任何一方说明真实想法。

理解关系，仍需要倾听、沟通和双方真实经验。

情境三 · 资源与变化

同样一个目标，在资源充足与资源紧张时，可能具有不同的现实可行性。

构型阅读可以帮助提出问题。

真实的预算、责任、支持和风险仍需另外核对。

一个重要区别

模型能够提出观察角度，但现实条件决定哪些行动真正可行。

zh-Hans.title: 从你的出生资料，建立本次个人构型。
zh-Hans.html:
输入准确出生日期、出生时间及已确认的出生地点，按照 PHI Configuration 正式采用的规则进行计算。

免费计算使用现有确定性引擎，不调用 LLM。

第一步 · 确认资料

出生日期、准确时间、地点及本次计算所需的同意。

第二步 · 查看你的构型

完成计算后，立即显示本次实际支持的个人构型、相关位置和八层结构。

第三步 · 阅读免费内容

免费阅读包括已准入的基础结构解释、可探索的构型图，以及正式开放的固定报告页。

这些内容不需要先购买完整报告。

第四步 · 对照现实

你可以选择记录某项解释是否与你已经知道的经历相符、部分相符、不相符，或暂时无法判断。

这些回应不会改变原计算结果，也不会自动被当成方法有效性的证明。

zh-Hans.title: 从构型图，进入更深入的十章阅读。
zh-Hans.html:
免费版本帮助你认识自己的计算结构。

完整报告则将获准的构型关系、解释和不同主题组织成连续的十章内容。

正式章节包括：

01 · 构型概览

02 · 出生与 Design

03 · 行星驱动

04 · Gate 与 Line

05 · 现实语法与问题

06 · 能力与激活

07 · 载体与环境

08 · 体验与表达

09 · 行动与身份

10 · 贡献与资源

此外，现实对照、PHI 牌卡反思、导航与持续属于已有的互动阅读内容，其权限和交付状态与正式十章正文分别确认。

完整报告的价值

更深入地理解计算结构、不同层次之间的关系，以及它们如何成为有边界的个人阅读。

你不仅能够阅读结构，还可以通过相应的现实对照重新检查自己真正知道什么、仍然不清楚什么。

zh-Hans.title: 一次购买，成为可以持续回看的个人阅读。
zh-Hans.html:
决定购买完整报告时，先注册或登录 PHI OS Account。

确认正式商品、价格、报告对象、计算版本及资料使用条件后，再进入付款和正式生成流程。

当报告完成交付，将绑定到对应账户。

客户可以按购买权益阅读、下载与重新下载原有报告版本。

账户保存不改变计算结果和解释边界，也不意味着未来新增的报告版本会自动覆盖旧文件。

未正式开放购买时，显示准确的当前状态，不将免费读取误作完整付费报告。

zh-Hans.title: 可以比较不同阅读，但不能混淆不同来源。
zh-Hans.html:
PHI Configuration 拥有独立的计算与解释规则。

八字、紫微、占星、数字学、人类图等方法也继续保留各自的结构。

你可以主动比较不同方法提出的问题，以及它们与你现实经验之间的联系。

但方法之间的相似性不是事实证明，差异也不代表一定有一种方法错误。

PHI OS 不用多种象征解释进行投票，替你决定你是谁。

你的现实仍然拥有优先位置

个人工作、家庭责任、财务情况和真实选择，不应被某一种模型直接覆盖。

zh-Hans.title: 一张构型不是终点，而是新的观察起点。
zh-Hans.html:
从出生资料建立结构，从结构认识关系，再从关系提出值得探索的问题。

接下来，你仍可以继续阅读 PHI OS Knowledge，或主动进入 Personal、Family、Business、Financial 等不同现实视角。

PHI Configuration 的目的，不是替你完成所有判断，而是让你的判断能够区分模型、依据、现实与未知。

PHI OS — One Real World. Six Perspectives.

理解构型，保留现实，继续选择。
